evidence.observation: Monotonic pressure rise through growth, 3.06→3.34 Torr (k=20→26), ~10x the ~0.03 Torr baseline scatter seen in purge/ramp
MFC steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure climb is not from a flow change
Thermocouple holds 750 °C at ~46% heater power, thermal control nominal
Sensor not installed; atmosphere/leak state cannot be verified as the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (sensor absent) or an equivalent leak/blockage discriminator — e.g. a brief Ar setpoint step or pump-down/valve-response test: pressure tracking flow implies exhaust restriction, pressure insensitive to flow implies an air in-leak.
